name: Indian Air Force Agniveervayu
summary: Four-year enrolment in the Air Force as an Agniveervayu after Class 12 (science or other streams) or a diploma. Online test, adaptability tests, fitness test and medicals. Agnipath package from Rs 30,000 a month.

status.note: Two intakes a year. Intake 01/2027: notified 12 January 2026, applications to early February (reopened 3 to 10 March), online test on 30 and 31 March 2026.

posts.name: Agniveervayu
posts.responsibilities: Air Force technical and ground trades.
posts.notes: Science and non-science streams have separate tests.

age.summary: 17.5 to 21 years (birth-date window set per intake).

education.summary: Science: Class 12 with Maths, Physics and English, 50% overall and 50% in English, or a 3-year engineering diploma. Other streams: Class 12 in any subject with 50% and 50% in English.

eligibility.physical: Fitness test and Air Force medical standards.
eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

stages.name: Physical fitness test and adaptability tests

selection.meritCalculation: All-India merit from the online test among those who pass the later stages.

salary.officialGrossNote: First-year package Rs 30,000 a month: Rs 21,000 in hand and Rs 9,000 to the Agniveer Corpus Fund, matched by the government.
salary.pension: No pension or gratuity. Seva Nidhi of about Rs 11.71 lakh (tax free) after four years.
salary.notes: Life insurance of Rs 48 lakh during service.

progression.post: Regular cadre (up to 25% of each batch)

career.promotionNotes: Retention depends on performance during the four years.

benefits.detail: Rs 48 lakh life insurance during service; about Rs 11.71 lakh Seva Nidhi at exit.

workLife.stability: Fixed four-year term; regular cadre only for up to 25%.

difficulty.rationale: Class 12 level test with lakhs of applicants and fitness rounds.

ratings.rationale: Regular intakes, but only four years unless retained.

sources.title: AGNIPATH scheme for recruitment of youth in the Armed Forces (14 Jun 2022)
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Government of India

gaps: Test pattern and exact birth-date windows not reproduced.
dataQuality.notes: Package from the official PIB release; intake dates secondary.
